name: グループの履歴と退出操作
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. ONE actual Lighthouse component LH03-0025「グループの履歴と退出操作」. Image1 ORIGINAL is primary for grouping, color semantics, spacing, fine details and actual controls. Image2 Japanese mock secondary for exact content/lockedMeiryo typography and logical390x232; fix its mint spacer and lost red/green action distinctions. Image3 approved white/forestgreen style only.
Exactly FOUR full-width action rows arranged in TWO white rounded cards. Uppercard row1 exact「会話をエクスポート」forestgreen#1F6444 (source green Export chat); row2 exact「会話の履歴を消去」source RED destructiveaction. Lowercard row1 exact「グループから退出」RED; row2 exact「グループを報告」RED. Each card has one thin inset neutral divider between its2rows. A16px white vertical gap separates the2cards, no mintband. Match original's two groups and fine proportions. Alllabels leftaligned x16logical, consistent baselines, usable rowheights.
LOCK Meiryo Regular14px/24px tracking0 ALL4labels, singleline and sameweight/size; no heading, no bold. Source has NO rightchevrons/icons for these actions; add none. No favorite/addtolist rows, footercreationdate, members, badges, switches, confirmations, phone or outerappscreen.
Accent decision grounded in ORIGINAL: green export is a normal action; clear/exit/report are red destructive/safety actions. Retain these meaningful distinctions under current DESIGN section5; do not turn dangerous actionsgreen orneutral. No decorativecolor and noforcedfilled primarybutton.
Purewhite#FFFFFF canvas/cardfaces/gap, fine neutral outlines and restrained soft shadows, modest roundcorners, compact logical390x232 geometry. ONE complete component centered on landscape3:2 with modest margins, no clipping. Original controls/fine details override mock. Static raster candidate.
reviewNotes: 原画像の2つの操作群・緑の書き出し/赤い消去退出報告の意味を優先。モックは日本語とRegular14/24の副参照。出力を目視し4項目全文・上下2群・白い間隔・1本ずつの区切り・不要アイコンなし・白面/穏やかな影を確認。原画像の意味ある緑/赤のみ保持しモックのミント帯を除去。厳密な字体計測・実書出/消去/退出/報告・編集可能性・所有者承認は未検証。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
